comment: Dr. Johnson grew on me as the semester went on. He truly cares about his students. Very accessible over email and wants you to succeed. Sometimes his notes are confusing. His exams are fair in difficulty. To get an A was not easy and required constant attention. He's not a bad option at all, but be prepared to work.
He's nice and wants students to do well, but sometimes his lectures are unnecessarily confusing. He's a good professor, but not necessarily the best option.

This class is definitely not easy, but it's also a completely different class from previous years. It's not impossible to do well. You have to spend a lot of time teaching yourself and make sure to attend office hours. Dr. Johnson is super funny, and he's willing to help. Put in the work and don't expect your grade to be "given" to you.

Dr. Johnson completely revamped his inorganic lecture. Every notes, slideshow, and lab was just changed this past semester and I enjoyed this class. He is a great teacher and even better as making silly jokes in class. I know in previous years he had bad reviews but he changed everything for the better. I would recommend him. He goes into detail.

His lecture material does not align with the difficulty of his exams. He grades harshly and is unclear with what he marks off. I liked the final forgiveness but its practically necessary with how grueling and difficult his exams are. He made comments that he's proud he's the hardest prof and this rubbed me the wrong way. Not accessible.

This was the most stressful and awful class I have ever taken in my entire life. Dr. Johnson creates extremely hard tests that no one can get above a B or B- on. It is nearly impossible to succeed in his class and he is seldom available outside of class. Do not take it unless you want to ruin your GPA. Take anyone else at all costs!!!

BEST orgo 2 professor! Dr. Johnson is hilarious and gives so much practice material for the exams. Friday classes are optional and are used for review, which became really helpful as I got further into the course. Exams primarily make up the course grade, but he makes it easy to succeed!

Dr. Johnson is proud of the fact that many students leave this course no longer enjoying the subject. The environment additionally hindered my learning ability. When we asked for a final review, he expected us to complete 21 separate practice exams, which is unreasonable as these all together did not cover the entirety of potential exam material.
Dr. Johnson made me change my major. Lectures are horrible. Exams are even worse.

Dr. Johnson cares more about making jokes and hard exams than teaching chemistry. There is very infrequent practice on the material and homework and exams are incredibly more difficult than the work done in class. Dr. Johnson takes pride in the fact that he is the hardest 317 professor. Beware.

Just overall not a great professor. Even though the homework was based on completion, problem sets were a huge source of frustration as the lecture material barely touched on the assignments (if at all). His tests this semester were astronomically harder than the historic exams, so there was no room to study. Every test was thinking on the spot.

Johnson is a great guy who is very caring and wants his students to succeed. His homework was graded for completion which was very helpful because he gave you feedback on how to improve without losing points. He was accessible outside of class. Some of his lectures were confusing and not the best but tests weren't terrible.

Dr. Johnson is one of the best professors at UR. He makes Orgo, which is a very challenging subject, manageable. He is always willing to meet with you outside of class to answer questions and get help. He also curves the class MAD HARD. TAKE DR. JOHNSON if you can!
love him great teacher and really nice guy!!

Chem 317 is a tough course. I liked Dr. Johnson, his lectures are very organized and his nerdy puns make class far more bearable, however, he is still fairly new at teaching this material and I believe he's still working out the kinks. His exams in his 2nd year of teaching were significantly more difficult than last year's, so be sure to practice.

Also had him for CHEM206. Dr Johnson loves chemistry and loves teaching. He wants you to get it and as long as you ask, hell help. His lectures are super clear, and he writes his notes on the board so he stays at the same pace as you. His notes are also very well organized. Hes fairly tough but pay attention in class youll be fine

Had for lab. Solid professor, corny jokes (and chemistry pun t-shirts), willing to spend as much time as necessary outside of class to make sure you understand a concept. Tough grader, but you understand why you get things wrong. Amazing overall.

One of the funniest professors out there and gives organized lectures which is necessary especially for this type of class. His tests are however pretty difficult and class averages were alarmingly low. I think he knows that, but doesn't really see that as a sign that maybe giving super hard questions is keeping us from learning effectively.
Dr. Johnson is a great professor who makes organic chemistry fun to learn. The tests are definitely challenging but doable. I would recommend him!
